purpose: Overlay hazard intensity with network geometry, apply a documented impact function, and separate exposure from network consequence.
required_data: hazard raster or polygons with CRS
unlock_rule: Disabled for point-only CSV uploads unless a georeferenced hazard layer and documented impact function are added.

primary_sources.citation: Sohn (2006), Evaluating highway link significance under flood damage, Transportation Research Part A.
Pregnolato et al. (2017), The impact of flooding on road transport: a depth-disruption function, Transportation Research Part D.

known_limitations: Impact functions are hazard- and region-specific.
Representative points do not establish full link exposure.
Exposure and consequence must be reported separately before combination.
